C-CI-RUST-TEST-ARTIFACT-LIFECYCLE-EXECVE.Summary: Supersede the prior technical shell-gate design with a same-PID Node POSIX execve gate that preserves Cargo runtime environment, while retaining the same complete CI executable lifecycle.
C-CI-RUST-TEST-ARTIFACT-LIFECYCLE-EXECVE.Problem: The predecessor C-CI-RUST-TEST-ARTIFACT-LIFECYCLE was approved and exercised with a shell gate; its immutable spec/plan and actual synthetic evidence remain preserved. A Node gate was then a source spike after discovering macOS SIP strips Cargo DYLD environment through /bin/sh. This fresh approval precedes final execution of that corrected design. Root centrally supersedes/retires the predecessor; no retroactive owner answer or compliant-execution claim is inferred. Additional mandatory hygiene prerequisite for CI:F-003, not another original finding: delivery base e0f70a4ee86fcfe472ef47f25d08516b588919e1 correctly caches root target, but test.yml and ci.yml currently let Cargo retain project test binaries. Prior isolated target inventories demonstrate actual retained Mark executables. The original77 denominator and approved C-CARGO-WORKSPACE-CACHE/archive remain unchanged.

Goals.Goal: Preserve the original three calls exactly in working directory, package/target selection, features/flags, full default workspace harness selection, fixture filter, Cargo-managed runtime environment/order, output and success/failure gating.

Use one minimal generic Node22 lifecycle helper, separate from unfinished manual QA features. Record source revision, isolated run identity, exact artifact path and digest before native launch; record owned PID before POSIX exec or immediately at Windows native spawn before any further input.

Always await owned processes and remove exact task-owned project executable artifacts on success, test/compiler failure, cooperative cancellation, malformed/truncated compiler metadata and evidence/log-write exceptions. Preserve dependency/compiler caches and unrelated preexisting outputs.

Constraints.Constraint: Cargo remains the test orchestrator. Add JSON compiler metadata and a per-invocation runner around each selected executable, without rebuilding a narrower manual harness list or adding a bin filter to root calls. The helper preserves original CLI test arguments; workflow wrapper paths reflect each original cwd. Existing job/step timeout, condition, matrix, cache path/key/prefix, action pins and release/signing boundaries remain unchanged.

Use the exact existing actions/setup-node commit49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 and node-version22 in Rust jobs that need the helper. Use only Node built-ins; no npm install, dependency/lock/toolchain or workflow trigger/permission change.

POSIX runner gates same-PID Node process.execve after durable identity/PID evidence. Require a supporting Node22.15-or-newer POSIX runtime and fail closed before Cargo compilation when process.execve is unavailable; the exact existing setup-node action with node-version22 resolves the supported current22 line. Avoid a protected system shell that strips DYLD search variables on macOS. Preserve Cargo-provided environment through execve. This corrects the predecessor literal shell detail; no cleanup policy or test scope is reduced. Windows records the actual child PID in its spawn callback before further child input; report that platform distinction honestly. Evidence-write failure prevents gated execution or terminates/reaps only that runner's own ChildProcess.

Parent and runner cooperate on SIGINT/SIGTERM. Runners own their native ChildProcess, forward cancellation, await close and escalate a specifically owned unresponsive child after a bounded grace. Parent cancellation/evidence failures stop its own Cargo process and notify active runners; never broad process-name kills. A finally cleanup continues despite independent evidence errors and reports exact remaining paths on failure.

Snapshot only recognized workspace executable outputs under the actual Cargo target directory before invocation, including target triples/profiles. Register compiler-reported workspace executable artifacts before fallible digest/evidence handling. On incomplete metadata, cleanup created/changed recognized project executables relative to that snapshot. Prove containment and non-symlink file identity; never delete unchanged unrelated files, dependency executables, objects, rlibs, rmeta, dylibs or shared build caches. Do not claim cleanup succeeded if any owned process/artifact remains.

Keep source, recipe, identity/digest/PID records, logs and deletion receipts outside the cache. The exact helper run may use a cached workspace harness, which becomes owned by that run when selected for launch. Preexisting unrelated cache contents remain untouched. No hidden unowned cache sweep.

Do not mask Cargo's nonzero test/compiler result with cleanup success. Cleanup/evidence failure makes an otherwise successful step fail. Cooperative cancellation remains failure. No test retries, reduced selection, threshold/skips or altered test budgets.

Governed source maps/contracts and proposed M046/VM046 evidence remain synchronized. Root alone applies durable XML, archives, commits and publishes. No existing approved/archive bundle is edited. No production app/release/signing/dispatch or owner profile/key access.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No QA installer/platform feature publication, native app packaging, test-policy/filter redesign, cache mapping redesign, dependency cleanup or new original finding.

No promise of JavaScript finally execution after OS SIGKILL, runner power loss or machine termination; do not manufacture success receipts. Cooperative cancellation and all caught failure paths must be tested concretely.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Before/after workflow AST evidence proves that only the three Cargo run strings, the required exact Node setup steps and local contract comments change; every original argument/cwd/filter, action pin, cache mapping/control/timeout and release boundary is preserved.

Meaningful failure-first checks demonstrate missing wrapper/recording/cleanup before implementation. Actual synthetic executable children and temporary filesystem fixtures prove before-exec recording, PID evidence, normal/failing child status, full multi-target/default selection, unchanged explicit filter/cwd and Cargo-managed env.

Exercise SIGINT and SIGTERM with a cooperative child; exercise an unresponsive owned child and bounded reap. Inject before-launch identity/receipt failure, native on-spawn receipt failure, compiler/test stdout-log failure, metadata parse/truncation failure, missing metadata after output creation and cleanup/evidence-write failures. Every reachable owned process stops and every provable owned artifact is removed; unrelated baseline files/dependency objects remain byte-identical.

Cached selected harnesses are recorded/deleted after use. New/changed project outputs are removed after failed/truncated metadata, including normal project executable outputs built for test dependencies. Unsafe/outside/symlink artifact paths fail closed and are never deleted. Persistent cleanup failure is explicit with remaining paths and a failing step.

All new focused lifecycle/workflow tests and relevant existing M046 workflow/cache/action governance tests pass. Target assertions and diff checks pass at exact candidate source; preserve coverage/test limits. Optional scoped actual native harness verification uses only the worker's idle isolated CoW target with its own before-exec/cleanup proof; no app build is required for initial synthetic proof.

Private source/hash-bound approval, red/green logs, cleanup receipts and bounded root-only durable projection are supplied. Hosted three-platform behavior/cache speed remains unproven until ordinary CI; no public mutation by worker.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Actual temporary synthetic child/filesystem fault tests plus exact workflow AST preservation and source/cleanup records; no native app or release action. Root performs final durable lifecycle and publication gates.
